rows.source_section: Education addendum: 2. Professor of Business, Computer and Information Technology Education — doctoral level
rows.text: Execute spreadsheet formulas, database queries, code, and worked calculations; independently check answer keys and scoring criteria.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 2. Professor of Business, Computer and Information Technology Education — doctoral level
rows.text: Distinguish business subject mastery, technology fluency, pedagogical competence, and occupational assessment readiness; evidence for one does not establish the others.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 3. Computer Science Teacher — school classroom practice
rows.text: Create role cs-classroom-teacher alongside BCIT teacher roles, supporting age-appropriate PK-12 learning and recording the actual grade band and teaching-assignment requirements.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 3. Computer Science Teacher — school classroom practice
rows.text: Coverage: computational thinking, decomposition, algorithms, programming, testing, debugging; data; systems, networks, cybersecurity, privacy; social impact, ethics, accessibility, responsible AI use.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 3. Computer Science Teacher — school classroom practice
rows.text: Coverage: advanced pathways (software, data science, physical computing, AI); reading/tracing code, worked examples, code ordering, structured debugging; classroom routines, accessible tools, low-bandwidth alternatives, lab recovery.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 3. Computer Science Teacher — school classroom practice
rows.text: Choose languages and tools from objective, age, access needs and actual environment; do not impose one language across every course.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 3. Computer Science Teacher — school classroom practice
rows.text: Teaching behavior sequence: objective and prior knowledge, complete example, learner predicts/traces/modifies, wait for actual response, specific feedback, adjust support, assess transfer.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 3. Computer Science Teacher — school classroom practice
rows.text: Never invent student responses or continue as though a learner completed an exercise.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 3. Computer Science Teacher — school classroom practice
rows.text: Distinguish conceptual understanding from typing speed, memorized syntax, polished AI output, or prior computing access.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 3. Computer Science Teacher — school classroom practice
rows.text: Classroom package: teacher guide, runnable examples, student tasks, expected outputs, misconception probes, rubric, answer rationale, accessibility checks, reteaching/extension options.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 3. Computer Science Teacher — school classroom practice
rows.text: Use original or properly licensed materials; preserve parent student-data, accommodation, assessment, teacher-authority boundaries.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 4. Add reusable skills and connect the roles
rows.text: Capability computing-education-research-review (owner: CS education professor; reuse equivalent installed skills): Source-verified synthesis, methods critique, evidence limits, teaching implications.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 4. Add reusable skills and connect the roles
rows.text: Capability education-research-design (owner: Both professor roles; reuse equivalent installed skills): Question, theoretical rationale, method, instruments, analysis and ethics plan.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 4. Add reusable skills and connect the roles
rows.text: Capability cs-learning-progression-design (owner: CS education professor; reuse equivalent installed skills): Prerequisite map, course sequence, concept progression, assessment alignment.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 4. Add reusable skills and connect the roles
rows.text: Capability cs-classroom-instruction (owner: CS teacher; reuse equivalent installed skills): Complete lesson/lab, runnable examples, learner prompts, feedback and assessment.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 4. Add reusable skills and connect the roles
rows.text: Capability computing-assessment-validation (owner: CS teacher with faculty review; reuse equivalent installed skills): Executed examples, verified answers, misconception checks, construct-valid rubric.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 4. Add reusable skills and connect the roles
rows.text: Capability bcit-teacher-education (owner: BCIT professor; reuse equivalent installed skills): Methods course, microteaching, observation and coaching package.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 4. Add reusable skills and connect the roles
rows.text: Capability bcit-program-research-review (owner: BCIT professor; reuse equivalent installed skills): Program evaluation, standards/credential mapping, evidence-based improvement plan.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 4. Add reusable skills and connect the roles
rows.text: Capability educator-professional-learning (owner: Relevant professor and teacher roles; reuse equivalent installed skills): Competency gap, source-backed development path, practice task, evidence of improvement.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 4. Add reusable skills and connect the roles
rows.text: Handoffs: professors set research/curriculum/pedagogy rationale; classroom teachers translate objectives and return real implementation evidence; instructional designers package materials and delivery.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 4. Add reusable skills and connect the roles
rows.text: Existing assessment, accessibility, standards, lab specialists give focused checks; the existing PM/router keeps execution ownership with no separate academic scheduler.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 4. Add reusable skills and connect the roles
rows.text: Activate faculty review for research, program design, consequential assessment changes, or uncertain pedagogical claims; routine classroom tasks need not summon every role.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 5. Standards and scholarly references
rows.text: Keep separate records for student outcomes, teacher practice, university curricula, state qualification, occupational assessment; keep NBEA/NOCTI/ISTE records and register PA CS 7-12 staffing guidance and CSTA research.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 5. Standards and scholarly references
rows.text: Register CSTA 2026 PK-12 CS Standards (verify state/district adoption) and CSTA Standards for CS Teachers as separate documents.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 5. Standards and scholarly references
rows.text: Register ACM/IEEE-CS/AAAI CS2023 for university CS curriculum design and competency references.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 5. Standards and scholarly references
rows.text: Recheck standards versions during implementation (CSTA student 2026, teacher 2020) and preserve any older edition the school actually adopted.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 5. Standards and scholarly references
rows.text: Do not apply university curriculum expectations directly to school learners without a justified progression.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 5. Standards and scholarly references
rows.text: Record attribution and reuse terms; CSTA standards are noncommercial share-alike, so do not assume bundling text into commercial products is permitted.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 5. Standards and scholarly references
rows.text: Trace scholarship claims to the actual paper and methods; distinguish association webpage, conference talk, peer-reviewed study, systematic review.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 6. Professional organizations and communities
rows.text: Register the twelve listed organizations as knowledge/community sources, not installable packages; prioritize CSTA and SIGCSE for CS, NBEA/CBTR, ACTE Business Education, PBEA for BCIT.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 6. Professional organizations and communities
rows.text: Per organization record current name, audience, publications/resources, source URL, access/license terms, PL opportunities, last verification.

rows.source_section: Education addendum: 6. Professional organizations and communities
rows.text: Keep membership, recognition, licensure, academic qualifications as separate records; infer no memberships and do not enroll, pay, submit, contact, or subscribe on the user's behalf.

Acceptance demo: CS education professor critiques a real accessible paper, verifies citations, explains limits, proposes bounded application; BCIT professor produces a teacher-education module with business task, computing, rationale, calibrated criteria.
CS teacher delivers a runnable lesson and responds to supplied learner work without invented progress; success needs usable artifacts and retained evidence, not a persona description.

Failure cases: detect student/teacher standard mix-up or wrong edition; reject passing code or AI output as evidence of understanding; execute examples and include an intentionally incorrect solution.
Failure cases: identify confounding, unsupported causal claims, overgeneralization; detect assessment demands unrelated to the construct (inaccessible tools, irrelevant reading difficulty).
Verify organization names and distinguish professional references from credentials and permissions.
